name: breakout_retest_v2_independent_holdout
purpose: independent validation holdout; data health may be inspected before open, strategy performance must remain sealed until the holdout ends

frozen_rules.failure_condition: close < EMA20 AND close < EMA50 AND close < breakout_level
frozen_rules.watch_starts: next completed candle after failure detection
frozen_rules.recovery_condition: close >= EMA20 AND close >= EMA50 AND close >= breakout_level
frozen_rules.timeout_action: CLOSE at signal-bar close; execute on N+1 open
